name: Talli
description: Tagard's daughter, who teams up with Lisolo and defeats Karelon.

description_citations.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tagard, Talli and Karelon climb to the Institute to seek a wizard's aid, and Tagard convinces Alligarius Timni to join him.
timeline.quote: Tagard now convinces Alligarius Timni to accompany him to defeat Berimish

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Talli hires Recin as guide and warms to him and Viashino culture.
timeline.quote: Talli recruits the Garan Elf Recin to be her guide around Berimish.

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karelon's conspiracy is revealed and she wages war on the Viashino; Talli and Lisolo defeat her; Rael Gar is killed.
timeline.quote: Talli teams up with Lisolo, despite her prejudice towards the viashino, and eventually manages to defeat Karelon.

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Timni steals the Magewall Hub and defects to Suderbod; Talli sends Kitrin and Recin, who are captured but escape with Timni's help.
timeline.quote: Talli learns that Timni has stolen the Magewall Hub and has defected to the nation of Suderbod.

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Suder army attacks with En'Jaga; just before a rout, Timni restores the Magewall and stops the armies.
timeline.quote: the returned Timni manages to restore the Magewall and the advancing armies are stopped
